sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
2.9.0

  • Mobile-First User Management: Complete redesign of the Users/Team module with a unified responsive filters toolbar, collapsible mobile filter panel, and mobile card grid layout for team members.
  • Layout Polish: Introduced separate mobile and desktop headers with compact mobile tab navigation and floating 'More' dropdown for secondary tabs (Permissions, Attendance, Custom Roles).
  • Filter Sync Engine: New bidirectional filter synchronization between desktop inline filters and mobile collapsible filter panel with clear-all support.
  • Tab Navigation Overhaul: Synchronized tab active states across desktop and mobile navigation menus with deep-link support via URL query parameters.
  • Attendance Quick Actions: Mobile topbar punch button and responsive punch popover.
  • Leads CRM Refinements: Notion-inspired styling, team assignee support, quick status transitions, activity timeline logging, and SLA metrics.
